name: SDF Normal Estimation via Finite Differences
aliases: SDF Gradient Normal Estimation via Finite Differences
definition: A technique to approximate the surface normal by evaluating the distance function at a small offset along the light direction, avoiding explicit normal computation.
summary: SDF Normal Estimation via Finite Differences computes surface normals by numerically approximating the gradient of the distance function using axis-aligned offsets, distinguishing itself from methods relying on discrete vertex positions or tetrahedral stencils.
